current_language_conclusion.reason: Accepted P000 supplies Cell identity, adjacency/path count, named axes and optional PF10 local data, but no typed relation or conversion law identifying native contact, exclusion, or Cell×Support incidence. Carrier contact, conflict graphs and FCA are downstream/comparison structures only until their native input relation is typed.

signature_atlas.refinement: NO_CURRENT_LAW; any future Cell/Support refinement must declare exact pullback, pushforward, or monotone naturality separately

primitives: one role-tagged relation whose restrictions decode K,X,I
signature_atlas.minimality: pair channel must have at least four local states to recover two independent Boolean pair selectors; incidence channel must have at least two local states

three semantic role fibers or an equivalent amount of typed information are necessary: merging the two pair roles forces K=X, while merging SUPPORT with a pair role loses Cell×Support typing or silently assumes self-duality

signature_atlas.extra_law: equivariant bijection delta:Cell↔Support and I(c,delta(d)) iff K(c,d)
X(c,d) iff c!=d and exists s with I(c,s) and I(d,s)
forced_conversions: SUPPORT implies EXCLUSION by declared overlap law

minimality_theorem.statement: Without an independently justified conversion law, the three selector relations carry 2*binom(n,2)+n*m independent Boolean degrees of freedom on |Cell|=n and |Support|=m. Any lossless local typed representation must therefore distinguish four CONTACT/EXCLUSION states on every unordered Cell pair and two states on every Cell×Support slot. A role-tagged sum attains this bound exactly but creates no semantic implication.

same_carrier_same_readout_countermodel_b.symmetry: C4 simultaneous translation on Cell and Support

downstream_interfaces.packing: Only X/NONOVERLAP may be turned into a conflict graph; independent-set, Hoffman, matching, periodic or packing machinery starts after X is typed. K/contact alone is insufficient.
downstream_interfaces.mahler: Only I/Cell×Support incidence licenses FCA/Galois derivation and closure; classical FCA then applies, but no self-dual identification or Mahler geometry follows without further typed data.
downstream_interfaces.contact: K may feed native contact/readout neighborhoods only after K itself is supplied or derived; carrier first-shell contact is not a native identity theorem.
downstream_interfaces.shared_witness: If SIG2 is later authorized, K/X/I are exact projections of J, but J is a strictly stronger typed primitive and does not prove selector equivalence.
